D: A rude, obsessive author falls for the only waitress who'll put up with him.

Thick bacon rashers baked on a rack at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp, cut into pieces and served warm with maple syrup for dipping.
Toast squares topped with scrambled egg, crisp bacon and chives
Mini toasts topped with soft scrambled egg and crispy bacon pieces, laid out on a plate.
the road trip to Baltimore with Simon and Carol

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in crushed pretzels and baked crunchy, with a honey mustard dip, packed in a box for the car. Heat the oven to 210C. Crush 150g salted pretzels to coarse crumbs. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in 40g plain flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then the pretzel crumbs, pressing to coat. Lay on a lined, oiled tray, spray with oil and bake 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through. Mix 80g Dijon mustard, 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo for dipping.
M: Pan-fried crab cakes with Dijon, spring onion and crisp breadcrumbs
Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, shaped into cakes and pan-fried until golden, with lemon and a green salad.
Café meatloaf with brown sugar glaze
the New York café where Carol waits tables

Beef meatloaf with onion, garlic and herbs, baked under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttery mash and minted peas. Heat the oven to 180C. Mix 1kg beef mince, 1 grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 80g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tray. Mix 80ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and spread over. Bake 1 hour, rest 10 minutes and slice. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk, and 400g peas boiled with mint.
W: Biscuit crust, vanilla custard, sliced banana and whipped cream
A crumb crust filled with vanilla custard and sliced banana, finished with a deep layer of whipped cream.
K: Strong chilled coffee blended with vanilla ice cream and milk

Cold strong coffee blended with vanilla ice cream and milk until thick, poured into tall diner glasses and topped with whipped cream and cocoa. Brew 250ml strong coffee and chill it for at least 1 hour. Blend the coffee with 8 big scoops (about 500g) vanilla ice cream, 250ml cold milk and 1 tbsp caster sugar until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and dust with cocoa. Serve with long spoons and straws.

s.note: Thick bacon baked crisp, with maple syrup on the side
s.how: Lay 12 rashers of thick bacon on a rack over a tray. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp. Cut into pieces and serve warm with a small bowl of maple syrup for dipping. Save a piece for the dog.

s.note: Toast squares topped with scrambled egg, crisp bacon and chives
s.how: Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and chop. Scramble 6 eggs softly in butter. Toast white bread, cut into small squares and top each with egg, bacon pieces and snipped chives. Serve on a plate at the usual table.

m.note: Pan-fried crab cakes with Dijon, spring onion and crisp breadcrumbs
m.how: Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a spoon of Dijon, sliced spring onion and breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill. Pan-fry until golden on both sides and serve with lemon and a green salad.

w.note: Biscuit crust, vanilla custard, sliced banana and whipped cream
w.how: Crush 250g plain sweet biscuits with 110g melted butter and press into a 23cm pie dish. Cook 600ml milk, 4 egg yolks, 100g sugar and 50g cornflour until thick, add 1 tsp vanilla and cool. Layer 3 sliced bananas in the crust, spread over the custard and top with 300ml whipped cream. Chill 3 hours.

d.note: Strong chilled coffee blended with vanilla ice cream and milk
d.how: Brew 250ml strong coffee and chill it for at least 1 hour. Blend the coffee with 8 big scoops (about 500g) vanilla ice cream, 250ml cold milk and 1 tbsp caster sugar until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and dust with cocoa. Serve with long spoons and straws.
